converted: Converted to a plain range; formulas now use cell addresses
couldNotCreate: Could not create the table there. Check the range and its protection.
couldNotUpdate: Could not update the table. It may have been removed, or its totals row is protected or outside the sheet.
hasHeader: My data has a header row (otherwise one is added above it)
headerProtected: The new header row would be protected. Unprotect those cells before creating the table.
hint: Formulas can name the table's columns: =SUM(Sales[Amount]), or [@Qty]*[@Price] for the same row. Typing just under or beside the table extends it.
merged: The range has merged cells. Unmerge them before creating the table.
noRoomHeader: A header row cannot be inserted above the data: the sheet has content on its last row.
overlapsPivot: That range overlaps a pivot table. Choose a different range.
protectedChange: This sheet is protected. Unprotect it to change the table.
protectedConvert: This sheet is protected. Unprotect it to convert the table.
rangeOnSheet: Enter a range on this sheet
totalsProtected: The totals row is protected. Unprotect it or turn off the totals row.
totalsRow: Totals row (a SUBTOTAL under each numeric column)
totalsSplitPivot: Making room for the totals row would split a pivot table or push it past the sheet limits.
withinLimit: Choose a range within {range}, leaving room for the header and totals rows.
